info.title: Crucible
info.description: The REST API of Crucible, observability and analytics for AI agents and MCP servers. Errors are `application/problem+json` documents with a stable `code`.

post.description:
Records the corrected output of a trace, a span or a session; `retracted: true` removes the correction.
The body is at most 1 MiB.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project, or the project has not sent the target.

get.description:
Where the project's data begins and ends inside its retention, with the retention horizon, the widest
window a request may ask for and the server's clock.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

get.summary: Get the facts of a target
get.description: The effective facts of a trace, a span or a session: per key the latest write, without retracted keys.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: The target trace (32 hex characters); with `span_id`, its span.

parameters.name: span_id
parameters.description: The target span (16 hex characters), with `trace_id`.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: The target session, instead of a trace.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project, or the project has not sent the target.

post.description:
Writes a score with `source = feedback` about a trace, a span or a session. A score with the same name
(and `score_id`) replaces the earlier one; `retracted: true` removes it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project, or the project has not sent the target.

get.description:
The values of a filter field of a metrics source in the window, most frequent first, with how many spans
carry each. The fields are those of the metrics schema.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source whose field is looked up.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: A filter field of the source.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only values that start with this text.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

post.description: Sets the `bookmarked` or `public` flag of a trace, a span or a session.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project, or the project has not sent the target.

post.description:
The series of up to four measures of a source, bucketed in time and split by up to two dimensions, with
at most 500 buckets per series, 20 keys and 10,000 points. Keys beyond `top_n` form an `other` series for
additive measures; for percentiles they are left out and `truncated` is set.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

get.description:
Per source: the measures with their units and aggregations, the dimensions, the filter fields with
their operators, the granularities and the caps of a query. Generated from the registry the query
compiler uses.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

post.description:
The spans that started in the window whose input, output or metadata hold the query, newest first, each
with the matching part of its fields. Search reads the store only: a span acknowledged moments ago may be
missing, and the page then says `consistency: lagging`.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

get.description:
The field's bytes as stored: JSON or text, cut at the size cap when the span named it in
`truncated_fields`, so possibly no longer valid JSON. A `Range: bytes=<first>-[<last>]` header asks for part
of it; other forms of the header are answered with the whole field. A span the store does not serve yet is
read from the write-ahead log.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: `bytes=<first>-[<last>]`: one byte range of the field.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The span's start time as the API returned it (RFC 3339): it locates the span's payload.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: `1` sends the field as a download (`Content-Disposition: attachment`).

ETag.description: The same for every range of the field.

206.description: The range of the field that `Range` asked for.

404.description: `not_found`: no such payload (it expired under the payload retention, or the span was never stored), or the key cannot see the project.

416.description: The range starts past the end of the field: `Content-Range: bytes */<length>`.

503.description: `telemetry_store_unavailable`, also while the span may not be readable yet.

post.description:
Adds a tag to a trace, a span or a session, or removes it. A trace's effective tags are the tags it was
sent with, plus the added ones, minus the removed ones.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project, or the project has not sent the target.

get.description:
The traces whose head (the root span, or the earliest span while the root has not arrived) started in the
window, newest first. With `since`, the traces whose head arrived after that head cursor instead.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window over the traces' start times, inclusive (RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
End of the window, exclusive (RFC 3339). The window may span at most the project's maximum (default
30 days).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same window.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Live tail: the `head_cursor` of a first page or of the previous live-tail response, with the same
window. Not combined with `cursor`.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

get.description:
Every span of the trace up to 5,000 spans; above that, the root spans and their direct children with
`paged: true`. An empty trace with `partial` or `lagging` in `meta` means the trace may exist but could not
be read in full.

parameters.name: hint_time
parameters.description:
When the trace is known to have started, for example from the list (RFC 3339). Accepted and checked;
the read does not need it yet.

404.description: `not_found`: no such trace, or the key cannot see the project.

get.summary: List the children of a span
get.description:
One page of the direct children of `parent_span_id`, in start order, each with `child_count`: how large
traces are read below their first two levels.

parameters.name: parent_span_id
parameters.description: The span whose direct children to list (16 hex characters).

404.description: `not_found`: no such trace, or the key cannot see the project.

Consistency.description: Whether a response reflects every span this node acknowledged before the request arrived.

Correction.description: The latest correction of an output.

CorrectionRequest.description: The body of `POST projects/{project_id}/corrections`: the corrected output of the target.

corrected.description: The corrected output: any JSON value.

retracted.description: Retracts the correction: the target has none afterwards.

session_id.description: The target session, instead of a trace.

span_id.description: The target span (16 hex characters), with `trace_id`.

trace_id.description: The target trace (32 hex characters); with `span_id`, its span.

DataBounds.description: Where a project's data begins and ends, inside its retention, with minute precision.

max_window_days.description: The widest window a list or analytics request may ask for.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the response is.

retention_horizon.description: The first instant that has not expired; null when the project keeps its data forever.

server_time.description: The server's clock when it answered.

FactRef.description: The fact that holds a value: the latest write of its key.

author_id.description: The user or API key that wrote it.

FactWritten.description: What the server assigned to a fact it made durable.

key.description:
The key latest-wins resolves over: the score name (with `#` and the score id), the tag, the flag or
`output`.

target_time.description:
The start of the target the fact is filed under: a trace's earliest known start, a session's first
seen.

version.description: The server's microsecond clock at acceptance: of two facts of one key, the greater version wins.

Facts.description: The effective facts of one target: per key the latest write, without retracted keys.

oneOf.description: The `bookmarked` flag; null when it was never set.
The correction of the output; null when there is none.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the response is.

oneOf.description: The `public` flag; null when it was never set.

tags.description:
The latest edit of each tag. The target's effective tags are its ingest tags plus the added ones minus
the removed ones.

FeedbackRequest.description: The body of `POST projects/{project_id}/feedback`: one score with `source = feedback`.

oneOf.description:
How to read the value; by default `numeric` for a number, `boolean` for a boolean and `categorical` for
a string.

metadata.description: A JSON object, at most 16 KiB.

retracted.description: Retracts the score of this name (and id): the target has no value for it afterwards.

score_id.description: The client's id of this score: scores with the same name and different ids are kept apart.

session_id.description: The target session, instead of a trace.

span_id.description: The target span (16 hex characters), with `trace_id`.

trace_id.description: The target trace (32 hex characters); with `span_id`, its span.

FieldError.description: One invalid part of a request.

code.description: A stable code for the failure, such as `required` or `invalid_timestamp`.

message.description: A developer-facing message; clients show their own copy.

pointer.description: A JSON pointer to the invalid part: `/<name>` for a query or path parameter.

FilterValue.description: One value of a filter field.

count.description: How many spans carry it in the window.

FilterValues.description: The answer of `GET projects/{project_id}/filter-values`: the most frequent values first.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the answer is.

truncated.description: Whether more values exist than `data` holds.

FlagRequest.description: The body of `POST projects/{project_id}/flags`: sets a flag of the target.

session_id.description: The target session, instead of a trace.

span_id.description: The target span (16 hex characters), with `trace_id`.

trace_id.description: The target trace (32 hex characters); with `span_id`, its span.

FlagValue.description: The latest value of a flag.

Granularity.description: The bucket width of a metrics query.

HeadKind.description:
Why a trace appears in the list: its root span, or its earliest span while no root has
arrived.

IoShape.description: How a span's input and output are structured, which tells a viewer how to show them.

McpBounds.description: MCP operations by the side that captured them.

client.description: Operations captured on the client side.

server.description: Operations captured on the server side.

MeasureRequest.description: One measure of a query and how it is aggregated.

aggregation.description: An aggregation the measure allows: `sum`, or a percentile `p50`, `p90`, `p95`, `p99`.

measure.description: A measure id of the source in the metrics schema.

Meta.description: How complete and how fresh a telemetry response is.

as_of.description: The instant the response describes; for a list, the `as_of` its first page fixed.

consistency.description: `strong` when the response reflects every span this node acknowledged before the request arrived.

partial.description: Whether rows may be missing, for the reason in `partial_reason`.

partial_reason.description: Why rows may be missing; present only when `partial` is true.

oneOf.description: The field is one of the values (operator `in`).

in.description: The field is one of the values (operator `in`).

MetricsFilter.description:
A filter over a source's filter fields: conditions combined with `and`, `or` and `not`. The fields and
the operator each takes are in the metrics schema.

bucket.description: The first instant of the bucket.

value.description: The value in the measure's unit; null for a percentile of a bucket without spans.

dimensions.description: Up to two dimension ids of the source, to split the series by.

oneOf.description: What an empty bucket holds; `zero` by default.
A filter over the source's filter fields.

timezone.description: The time zone of the buckets. Only `UTC` is supported yet.

to.description: End of the window, exclusive (RFC 3339). At most the project's maximum window.

top_n.description: With dimensions: how many keys to return, 1 to 20, default 20.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the answer is.

partial_last_bucket.description: Whether the last bucket ends after `as_of` and may still grow.

saturated.description: Whether a value above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

source_tier.description: Where the measures were read: `rollup` or `core`.

truncated.description: Whether keys beyond `top_n` were left out of a percentile measure, which has no `other` series.

sources.description: One entry per source with metrics.

MetricsSeries.description: One series: one measure of one dimension key, or of the `other` key.

key.description: The dimension values of the key; empty without dimensions and for the `other` series.

other.description: Whether this series sums every key beyond `top_n` (additive measures only).

unit.description: The unit of the values: `count`, `tokens`, `usd` or `us`.

PartialReason.description: Why a response may be missing rows.

detail.description: What went wrong with this request, for logs and developers.

errors.description: The invalid parts of the request, for `validation_failed`.

limit.description: The limit the request exceeded, for `query_too_broad`.

request_id.description: The request id, also sent as `X-Request-Id`.

retry_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, for `rate_limited`.

suggested_granularity.description: A coarser granularity that fits the caps, for `query_too_broad` on metrics.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type.

ProblemCode.description:
The stable code of a problem. Clients branch on it; `title` and `detail` are for logs
and developers.

SchemaDimension.description: A dimension of the metrics schema.

high_cardinality.description: Whether the dimension can take many values.

type.description: `string`, or `enum` for a closed set of names.

SchemaFilterField.description: A filter field of the metrics schema.

SchemaLimits.description: The caps of a source's queries.

max_dimensions.description: The most dimensions of one query.

max_measures.description: The most measures of one query.

max_points.description: The most points in one answer.

max_series.description: The most dimension keys; the rest form the `other` series of additive measures.

SchemaMeasure.description: A measure of the metrics schema.

additive.description: Whether the values of two keys add up to the value of both: true for sums.

unit.description: The unit of its values: `count`, `tokens`, `usd` or `us`.

comment.description: The comment; empty in trace lists.

metadata.description: The metadata object; null when there is none, and in trace lists.

score_id.description: The client's score id; null when the score was written without one.

ScoreDataType.description: How to read a score's value.

ScoreValue.description: A score's value: a number for `numeric`, a boolean for `boolean`, a string for `categorical` and `text`.

SearchFragment.description: A run of a snippet's text.

highlighted.description: Whether it matched: a token of the query, or in a phrase search the phrase.

SearchHit.description: One hit: a span and where it matched.

matches.description: The fields with a match to show. Empty when the matches lie past the snippets.

trace_id.description: The span's trace: 32 lowercase hex characters.

cut_after.description: Whether the field may go on after the snippet.

cut_before.description: Whether the field goes on before the snippet.

fragments.description:
The snippet around the field's first match, as fragments in order: at most 240 bytes. Empty for
`metadata`, whose matching entries are the query's terms.

SearchMode.description: How the tokens of a query combine.

SearchPage.description: One page of hits, newest first.

data.description:
The hits. A page can hold fewer hits than its size, even none, while `has_more` is true: phrase
candidates whose snippets lack the phrase are left out.

meta.description:
How complete and how fresh the page is. Search reads the store only, so spans acknowledged moments
ago may be missing, and the page then says `lagging`.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same query, mode, fields and window.

fields.description: The fields to search, each once; default `input` and `output`.

from.description: Start of the window over the spans' start times, inclusive (RFC 3339).

query.description:
What to find, at most 1,024 bytes. For `input` and `output` it is split into tokens as those fields
are; for `metadata` its whitespace-separated terms are `key=value` entries. At most 64 tokens.

to.description:
End of the window, exclusive (RFC 3339). The window may span at most the project's maximum (default
30 days).

SeriesKey.description: One dimension value of a series key.

SourceSchema.description: What can be queried of one source.

granularities.description: The explicit granularities, finest first; `auto` picks among them.

oneOf.description: The number of direct children, on paged traces and on children pages; null otherwise.
How the span's input and output are structured; null for a span the store does not serve yet.

model.description: The model the provider reported; empty for spans without one.

parent_span_id.description: The parent span, or null for a root span.

saturated.description: Whether a count above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

SpanPage.description: One page of the direct children of a span, in start order. Each carries `child_count`.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the page is.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

StatusCode.description: The OTel status of a span.

TagEdit.description: The latest edit of a tag.

op.description: Whether it was added or removed.

TagRequest.description: The body of `POST projects/{project_id}/tags`: adds a tag to the target or removes it.

op.description: `add` or `remove`. Removing a tag the trace was sent with hides it.

session_id.description: The target session, instead of a trace.

span_id.description: The target span (16 hex characters), with `trace_id`.

trace_id.description: The target trace (32 hex characters); with `span_id`, its span.

TimeRange.description: The first and last minute with data; both null when there is none.

TraceDetail.description:
One trace. Up to 5,000 spans it holds every span; above that it holds the root spans and
their direct children, and `GET .../spans` pages the rest.

facts.description: The trace's facts: effective tags, flags, scores and the correction of its output.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the response is.

paged.description:
False: `spans` holds every span. True: the root spans and their direct children, at most 1,000, each
with `child_count`.

span_count.description: Spans in the trace. Exact when `paged` is false.

spans.description: The spans in start order. Empty only when `meta` says the response is partial or lagging.

TraceFacts.description: The facts a trace view shows.

oneOf.description: The correction of the trace's output; null when there is none, and in trace lists.

public.description: The `public` flag; null when it was never set.

scores.description: The scores, by name. In trace lists they carry no comment or metadata.

tags.description: The effective tags: the tags the trace was sent with, plus the added ones, minus the removed ones.

TraceListItem.description:
One trace of the list: its head (the root span, or the earliest span while the root has not arrived) and
the trace's merged aggregates.

duration_us.description: From the trace's first span start to its last span end, in microseconds.

environment.description: The head span's environment; empty until the store serves the head.

facts.description: The trace's facts. Scores carry no comment or metadata here, and there is no correction.

head_kind.description: Whether the head is the root span.

release.description: The head span's release; empty until the store serves the head.

saturated.description: Whether a count above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

session_id.description: The trace's session, picked like the trace name.

start_time.description: The head span's start, the list's sort key.

tags.description:
The effective trace tags: the head's tags, which are empty until the store serves the head, plus the
tags added by edits, minus the removed ones.

total_cost_usd.description: The trace's total cost in USD.

trace_name.description: The trace name: the root span's, else the latest non-empty one; empty when no span set one.

user_id.description: The trace's user, picked like the trace name.

TraceListPage.description:
One page of the trace list, newest first; or, for a `since` request, the traces that arrived after the
head cursor.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists, or, for live tail, whether more traces arrived than `data` holds.

head_cursor.description: The cursor to pass as `since` for live tail; set on first pages and live-tail responses, else null.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the page is.

new_count.description: For live tail only: how many traces arrived, saturating at 100.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page and on live-tail responses.

project_key.description: A project's secret key (`csk_...`) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

tags.name: facts
tags.description: Scores, tags, flags and corrections written about traces, spans and sessions.

tags.name: metrics
tags.description: Time series over the project's spans and traces, their schema and filter values.

tags.name: search
tags.description: Full-text search over the spans' inputs, outputs and metadata.

tags.name: traces
tags.description: Traces, their spans and their payloads, and the project's data bounds.
